definition: Evidence of how AI assistants participate in product discovery, comparison, recommendation, selection, and transactions, and what shoppers report about that experience.
unit_of_analysis: An AI-mediated shopping episode with an explicit AI tool, shopping task, and product or service category.

evidence_lanes.episodes: Verified first-person reports or consented instrumented events. Self-selected reports do not estimate population prevalence.
evidence_lanes.surveys: Published consumer surveys, retaining question wording, sample, geography, date, and denominator when reported.
evidence_lanes.referrals: Published analytics of AI-sourced visits and conversion. A referral or conversion cohort is not an agent-executed checkout.
evidence_lanes.selection: Versioned buyer intents and an exact two-turn protocol on explicitly identified consumer-app surfaces. Preserve the first completed answer, all original failures and retries, contradictory final answers, model or mode labels, and independent product checks. API experiments remain a distinct surface. This September pilot is a nonrepresentative method check; no Agent Selection Share is published.
evidence_lanes.search_interest: Google Trends CSV exports for named AI-shopping search terms, United States, Web Search, All categories, past 12 months. Weekly 0–100 values are sampled and jointly normalized within the export; incomplete weeks are excluded. They are not AI shopping usage, consumer sentiment, purchase counts, or comparable across independently scaled exports.

publication_policy.transaction_rule: A purchase requires an explicit first-person completed purchase claim or a consented transaction event. Agent execution additionally requires explicit delegated checkout evidence.
publication_policy.sentiment_rule: Sentiment must target the AI shopping experience, not the product, merchant, or general AI opinion.
publication_policy.denominator_rule: Never merge survey percentages, referral growth, search interest, and episode counts into one rate or score.

source_policy: Collect only material with permitted access and stable provenance; do not scrape around access controls or assume commercial API rights.
limitations: Published aggregates may lack category and merchant detail
Search interest does not establish usage
AI referrals do not establish agent-executed purchases
Merchant or platform announcements describe capability rather than adoption
